title: APTES derived polymer with naphthalimide pendant for the fluorescent sensing of picric acid
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49948-49958
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03588K, Paper
Open Access

Sithara Soman, Kala R
A fluorescent silane-based polymer with a naphthalimide pendant was developed for the selective and sensitive detection of picric acid. The material exhibits excellent photophysical properties, making it a suitable tool for environmental monitoring.
